title: Sectionwise realization and fixed open coefficient calculations
statement: For finite coefficient maps and an open immersion, the section-normalized realization comparisons [def-sf-compact-support-restriction-data] compose with the specified coefficient compositor, and the canonical identity restriction comparison [def-sf-open-scalar-restriction-data] preserves sections. The fixed-scalar open comparison satisfies the open-adjunction unit equation [lem-weil-extension-by-zero-adjunction]. These are the existing private calculations preceding the intrinsic mate calculations.

source.place: Tags 00YV, 03DA, 03DI and 03CY; the existing sectionwise sheafification and adjunction-mate calculations, separated into a compile-sized proof module.

proof.text: Use the unit equation for uniqueness between composite left adjoints, evaluate the coextension component at the unit scalar, and obtain the fixed-scalar open-unit normalization.

Evaluate realization and the coefficient compositor on an arbitrary section. Both preserve it, so their two composites agree. Use the equivalence counit equation for the identity coefficient comparison.

lean.statement:
theorem realization_comp (T : Scheme.{u}) (φ : A →+* B) (ψ : B →+* C)
    (M : Sheaf (ProEt.topology T) (ModuleCat.{u + 1} (ULift.{u + 1, u} C))) :
    (proEtaleCoefficientRestrictScalars T φ).map
        ((sfRealizationRestriction T ψ).hom.app M) ≫
      (sfRealizationRestriction T φ).hom.app ((sfFixedRestriction T ψ).obj M) =
    (sfCoefficientRestrictionComp T φ ψ).hom.app
        ((sfIntrinsicModuleEquivalence T C).functor.obj M) ≫
      (sfRealizationRestriction T (ψ.comp φ)).hom.app M
